card.name: Small words in self-help advice text
card.fires_on: Common small words (commas, 'people', 'where', 'in', 'we', 'of', 'are') in the middle of general self-improvement or habit advice, just before the sentence continues. Not tied to drug labels.

modes.description: A comma after an example lead-in in productivity advice.
